objectives: To evaluate and synthesize the existing evidence on factors influencing the quality of life (QoL) of non-Hodgkin lymphoma survivors, and to comprehensively understand how these factors affect QoL after completion of primary treatment.
inclusion_criteria: Eligible studies involved adults aged >=18 years; were original quantitative, qualitative, or mixed-methods studies; investigated factors influencing QoL among non-Hodgkin lymphoma survivors; included participants diagnosed with non-Hodgkin lymphoma after completion of primary treatment; could be conducted in any setting (inpatient, outpatient, or home); were reported in English; and, per the review's search limits/update, fell within the 2014-2025 publication window.
exclusion_criteria: Excluded were studies that did not include the population of interest, involved animal subjects, or included Hodgkin lymphoma/non-Hodgkin lymphoma survivors who were still receiving treatment or had recurrent disease. The authors also excluded non-English studies and nonoriginal/noneligible publication types, including conference proceedings, abstracts, review articles, theoretical studies, pilot studies, protocols, dissertations, letters to the editor, opinion/viewpoint pieces, statement articles, government documents, and working papers.
